column1: # Per-match per-placement kill counts for ALGS regional fits.
#   region          one of: americas / emea / apac_n / apac_s
#   tournament      stable slug per finals event
#   match_number    1-indexed match number within the event
#   placement       1..20 final placement in that match
#   team_kills      scored kills the team at that placement earned in that match
# Source: Liquipedia per-match Standings tables for ALGS Year 4 / Year 5
# regional Pro League Finals (the same 19-event dataset described in
# docs/data_validation.md section 2-B). Global Finals are stored under
# "global" if added later (currently out of scope for region fits).

#   Bracket template's TeamOpponent / MS sub-templates. This replaces
#   the older manual-transcription rows whose origin was undocumented.
